summary: Inserts rows before the data, on a sheet or at a range.
description: Room is made first and the values are written into it, so nothing already on the sheet is overwritten. Given a sheet the rows go to its top; given a range they go above the range's first row and the values are written on its columns.
A cell whose text starts with `=` is written as a formula, not as text — the same rule the editor follows.
A failure inside the write — the service unavailable, the sheet gone — comes back as the error the service raised, with its stack. The document lock is released either way.

params.target: The sheet to insert into, or the range to insert at.
params.values: A matrix of rows: one array per row, all of the same length.
params.options: `afterFrozenRows` inserts below the frozen rows instead of at the very top. A range decides the position itself, so the option does nothing there.

returns: the sheet, so calls can be chained.

throws.InvalidSheetException: the first argument is neither a sheet nor a range.
throws.TypeError: the values are not a matrix with rows of equal length.

examples.title: Inserting at the top of a sheet
